# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Summary decision: NO capability edit shipped — run is STILL 100% infra-blocked

Identical situation to cand_0001. All 50/50 val rollouts in `./trajectories/` fail with the
**same** error at the API request-validation layer, before the model ever sees the prompt:

```
litellm.BadRequestError 400: Unsupported value: 'temperature' does not support 0.0
with this model. Only the default (1) value is supported. Model Group=azure/gpt-5.5
```

Evidence (checked programmatically across all 50 trajectory files this iteration):
- 50/50 traces match `temperature' does not support 0.0`.
- 50/50 have `output: null`; 0/50 have any `tool_calls`; 0/50 have `tokens>0`.
- Every task's own `score.feedback` states: "Infrastructure error, not a prompt defect;
  do not optimize against it."
- The model NEVER consumed the system prompt — the request is rejected on the
  `temperature` parameter, which is independent of prompt content.

The only editable artifact is `prompt.md` (system-prompt capability). Nothing in a system
prompt sets or influences the `temperature` request parameter — that is set by the harness
LLM client. Therefore **no prompt edit can change any rollout's outcome**: it fails the
VERIFIED test by construction (the failure is independent of prompt text), and a re-score
under the unchanged config is again 0.000 → the gate rejects it as net-zero. A speculative
prompt edit here is exactly the "padding with speculative/cosmetic edits" the instructions
forbid, AND it would risk regressions once (if) the config is fixed and real signal appears.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | temperature=0.0 rejected by azure/gpt-5.5 | ALL 50 | harness sends `temperature:0.0`; model only allows default(1) | INFRA (none of KNOWLEDGE/BEHAVIORAL/CAPABILITY-GAP) | NONE possible via system-prompt edit space |

No capability clusters exist: not a single task reached the model, so there is zero
capability signal (no reward-0-with-output, no partial-credit, no communication/omission).

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
None. No edit to `prompt.md` passes REAL+SAFE+VERIFIED, because there is no capability
failure to target and no prompt text can affect a `temperature` 400.

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- N/A — no edit shipped. Verification instead DISPROVED the viability of any prompt edit:
  the error occurs at request validation on the `temperature` field, so identical or
  rewritten text yields the identical 400. Confirmed 50/50 traces have `tokens=«redacted» and
  `tool_calls=[]`, i.e. the prompt was never evaluated.

## Required fix (OUT OF SCOPE for this capability — for the harness owner)
The rollout/LLM-client config must stop sending `temperature: 0.0` to `azure/gpt-5.5`:
(a) set `temperature=1` (the only supported value) or omit it so the API default applies;
(b) special-case gpt-5.5 in the temperature-setting code; or (c) add a model-group
fallback. Until then EVERY candidate (baseline included) scores 0.000 and the hill-climb
cannot progress — the loop is config-blocked, not prompt-blocked.

## Process & features used
- Serial diagnosis (read-only): enumerated all 50 trajectories, grepped error signatures,
  confirmed `output=null` / 0 tool_calls / 0 tokens on every one. No subagents/worktrees
  needed — the signal was uniform and required no fan-out.
- Prior iterations read from ./prior_iterations/ + ./RUNMAP.md: cand_0001 (only prior).
  Learned: it correctly diagnosed the same temperature-400 blocker, shipped no edit, and
  was rejected net-zero (expected under a config block). No cluster to build on.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- `prompt.md` is left byte-for-byte unchanged. It is a reasonable SpreadsheetBench policy
  (cell/sheet-level scoping to answer_position, literal values over live formulas,
  save-to-output_path, fix-on-traceback). Do NOT churn it while the run is infra-blocked —
  a future iteration can only get real capability signal AFTER the temperature config is fixed.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- ALL 50 tasks: uncontrollable infrastructure error (temperature 400), explicitly listed
  as infra noise ("no edit can fix them; do not change anything on their account").
  Editing on their account would be speculative and unverifiable.
